name: Robot cell equipment
summary: Modular cell equipment centered around robots, flexibly configurable and integrable based on process requirements, adaptable to various automation scenarios.
contentHtml:
In March 2026, TXAM's Huizhou Smart Manufacturing Base officially commenced full production, marking the formal establishment of the company's "Shenzhen-Huizhou Dual-Base 100,000 sqm Smart Manufacturing Base" strategic layout.

Dual-Core Drive, Production Leap

The Huizhou base covers an area of 60,000 sqm, featuring industry-leading smart production line designs with complete assembly, testing, and packaging systems. After production begins, the company's overall capacity will more than double, with annual output value expected to reach hundreds of millions of yuan.

Serving World-Class Global Customers

Leveraging expanded capacity and 19 years of technical expertise, TXAM is now capable of undertaking hundred-million-yuan orders from top global enterprises. The company will continue to deepen its focus on non-standard automation, providing higher-quality products and services to long-term partners such as TCL, Skyworth, Midea, Konka, and Changhong.

Looking ahead, TXAM will continue to advance smart manufacturing upgrades, contributing more to China's smart manufacturing sector.
